Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly by following the example there.

Goal
* Please explain the required task.

Input
* Please format all line numbers in <<bold>>.

* Please format all [[variables]].

Output
* Please change "Print the" to "The", and add the line number before it.

Constraints
* Please format all [[variables]].

* Please change 1000 to 100.

* Please change -10^9 to -100.

* Please change 10^9 to 100.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Thanks.

Hello! Hope you're doing well. Thanks again for the detailed feedback! I’ve updated the statement formatting, shortened the Goal section, formatted the variables and line numbers correctly, adjusted the constraints, and added the requested `write answer` statement to the stub generator. If you have any other suggestions for improving the puzzle, I’d be happy to hear them!
The task description is inconsistent with your solution.

You're right, thank you for pointing that one out! The statement describes a weighted sum, but some of the test outputs were still from an earlier version of the task. Now that I have updated the test cases and validators so that they'd match the described calculation and solution, please let me know if you have any more suggestions. ^^

Thank you for the prompt follow-up.

Just two more adjustments:

Constraints
* Please change the upper bound of N from 100 to 10.

Cases
* In Test 4, please change 50 to -50, and update the output accordingly. This is so that both Test 4 and Validator 4 expect a negative output.

Thanks again.
Also, consider using a more fitting name for the clash.
